 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"themselves"** is a reflexive pronoun used when the subject and the object of the verb are the same group of people or things. (स्वयं)

 
 
• **Example: **They prepared** themselves** for the upcoming challenge.
 
 
 
• **"themselves"** is used to emphasize the group of people or things performing an action on their own. (स्वयं)
 
 
• **Example: **The students organized the event by **themselves.**
 
 

Therefore, the correct sentence should be ''**..........and protect themselves__ while fighting crime...''**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**Other given options are incorrect and explained below.

**Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:**

 
• **ourselves **(स्वयं): Used when the subject and the object of the verb are the same group of people including the speaker.

 
 
• **Example:** We should trust **ourselves** to make the right decisions.
 
 
 
• **herself **(स्वयं): Used when the subject and the object of the verb are the same female person.
 
 
• **Example: **She made **herself **a cup of tea.
 
 
 
• **himself** (स्वयं): Used when the subject and the object of the verb are the same male person.
 
 
• **Example:** He fixed the car by** himself.**
